purpose: Teach: 櫻井/杉本/鳩山/齋藤/佐伯/中谷/中井/川島

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、指導教授の櫻井先生のご研究を継承しろ
lines.en: Ren, you need to build on Professor Sakurai's research — that's your starting point.
lines.style: Calm, direct instruction. Sets the frame without pressure. Measured pace. Slight emphasis on 'research' as the anchor. The tone of someone who's mapped this path before.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。杉本教授の論文を読み込みます
lines.en: Yes. I'll read through Professor Sugimoto's papers thoroughly.
lines.style: Quiet assent with a note of readiness. Small intake before speaking — gathering focus. Respectful but not servile. Slight nod in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、政治学者の鳩山先生のご論文も参照しろ
lines.en: And check the political theory work by Professor Hatoyama — that perspective matters for your framework.
lines.style: Casual addition, but weighted. Not a suggestion. Conversational delivery that carries authority. Slight pause before the reasoning.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。学会で齋藤助教のご発表を聴きます
lines.en: Understood. I'll listen to Assistant Professor Saito's presentation at the conference.
lines.style: Efficient acknowledgment. Short, clipped. No flourish — just capture and move. The voice of someone building a reading list in real time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、文献の佐伯先生のご論文も参考にしろ
lines.en: Don't skip Saebi's work on the historiography either — it'll ground your critique.
lines.style: Slight lean forward in tone. More specific now, less abstract. A touch warmer. The instruction of someone who's thought about why each piece matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の中谷先輩からご指導を仰ぎます
lines.en: Understood. I'll ask my senior lab mate Nakaya for guidance on the methodology.
lines.style: Respectful, careful enunciation. Slightly longer pause before the commitment. The tone of someone aware of the hierarchy — seniors, professors, the right channels.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外連携の中井教授と打ち合わせしろ
lines.en: Set up a meeting with Professor Nakai from the international partnership program — you need that connection.
lines.style: More direct this time. Almost commanding, but not unkind. The voice shifts to pragmatism — this is how things get done. Slight urgency without rushing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の窓口、川島事務官に申請します
lines.en: Got it. I'll contact the grants administrator Kawashima to file the research funding application.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly quieter. Methodical — ticking boxes. A hint of relief that the direction is clear now. Trail off slightly on the last phrase, as if already mentally moving to the next step.
